# OCI artifacts

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/oci.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **ORAS 1.3.6; crane 0.22.1; Cosign 3.1.4**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/v2/${AW_REPO}/`

## Before connecting

- Existing OCI repository and notes.txt file.
- HTTPS registry authority, without /artifactory.

Authentication: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.

Fresh client state: Use an empty DOCKER_CONFIG and a new pull output directory under AW_WORK. ORAS pulls into that directory, independently of Docker daemon layers.

## Configure

Registry authority includes a port when needed. AW_URL must be a bare HTTPS origin, with no path. Configuration files remain under AW_WORK.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export DOCKER_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/docker"
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
AW_REGISTRY="${AW_URL#*://}"
```

The pinned client receives runtime credentials; disable shell tracing. For automated use prefer its password-stdin facility if separately verified for the deployed release.

```sh
oras login "$AW_REGISTRY" -u "$AW_USER" -p "$AW_TOKEN"
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Remote repositories reject writes; use a local or one-node federated target.

```sh
oras push "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO/team/notes:v1" --artifact-type application/vnd.example.notes notes.txt:text/plain
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Native manifest/blob and referrer retrieval use the registry endpoint.

```sh
oras pull "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO/team/notes:v1" -o "$AW_WORK/pulled"
oras discover "$AW_REGISTRY/$AW_REPO/team/notes:v1"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Examples use HTTPS. CI alone adds --plain-http for its isolated loopback listener.
- Cosign can use the same registry, but key creation and signature trust policy are separate from this basic connection recipe.
